title.narrative: Supporting the resilience and sustainability of the health system in Burkina Faso - Burkina Faso (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Burkina Faso, RSSH, Programme d'Appui au Développement Sanitaire (PADS) (PADS)This program has the following goals: Améliorer l’état de santé de la population / Improve the health status of the population. The objectives of this program are: Augmenter l’utilisation des services de santé pour réduire les mortalités et morbidités dues aux maladies transmissibles et non transmissibles / Increase the use of health services to reduce mortality and morbidity due to communicable and non-communicable diseases. Rendre disponible les infrastructures sanitaires, les équipements et les produits de santé, selon les normes et les besoins, dans 95% des formations sanitaires / Make available health infrastructures, equipment and health products, according to standards and needs, in 95% of health facilities. Renforcer la lutte contre les maladies et la promotion de la santé à travers les attitudes et les pratiques individuelles, familiales et communautaires / Strengthen disease control and health promotion through individual, family and community attitudes and practices. Assurer la disponibilité et l’utilisation d’informations sanitaires de qualité pour la prise de décisions à tous les niveaux / Ensure the availability and use of quality health information for decision making at all levels

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for BFA-S-PADSP02
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Percentage of service delivery reports from community health units integrated/interoperable with the national HMIS
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
SD-6 Number of PEC-C conditions treated among children under five in target areas during the reporting period
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Percentage of reporting units which digitally enter and submit data at the reporting unit level using the electronic information system
Percentage of community health workers remunerated on time and in-full (as per their contract) every month during the reporting period
Percentage of health service delivery sites with a community-led monitoring mechanism in place
SD-Other 1: Rate of clinical IMCI application in health facilities (contact children)
CM-Other 1: Percentage of CHWs with inputs at community level (TDR and ACT)
Percentage of laboratories that have electronic test ordering and results return capability via a remote test order module of the LIMS
